raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner confused two different Prince Fredericks of Hesse-Kassel and incorrectly assumed that Prince William’s father was the 1771-born Prince Frederick (son of Charles of Hesse-Kassel and Louise of Denmark and Norway). This generational mix-up led the Planner to misidentify Louise as the paternal grandmother, despite earlier evidence indicating that William’s actual father was Prince Frederick of Hesse-Kassel (1747–1837), son of Frederick II and Princess Mary of Great Britain (the correct paternal grandmother).
